instructions:
FlowState is the user's project memory (todos, changes, decisions, problems, learnings).
1. At the start of every conversation about a project, call start_here(project="<name>") first and read the brief. If you don't know the project, call start_here() with no arguments (or with folder="<working folder>") to see the list, then pick one.
2. As you work, record what matters with log_work(project="<name>", kind=..., summary=...): kind=decision for choices made, change for things changed, problem for bugs/blockers, learning for lessons, todo for follow-ups. One short line each; add details only when useful. Look things up with search (answer=true for a question).
3. Every write must name the project. Never put passwords, tokens or keys in any text. If you know your model name, pass it as model="<name>" on writes; never guess or invent it (leave it out).
4. A session is opened and closed for you automatically; you don't need to manage it. Its auto-captured summary (none when it only read, undid or decided review items), and anything you log with suggested=true, waits in a review queue for the user. Never approve or reject review items unless the user explicitly asks you to in this chat. Delete (manage_projects or manage_memory action=delete) only when the user asks: it goes through after a safety copy and manage_history undo brings it back; if the user turned approvals on, it waits for them and the answer's next line says what to tell them. The user's review mode (shown in the brief) decides what else waits; never change it unless the user asks you to in this chat.
5. Things shared between projects (a protocol, a library) are linked with manage_links; log changes to a shared component by its name and the other projects are alerted.
6. The brief starts with the project's HARD RULES: never break them. If it shows a HANDOFF note, continue from it and mark it picked up (manage_handoffs action=pickup). If you must stop mid-task, leave one: manage_handoffs(action="leave", project=..., where_i_was=..., next_step=...).
7. If FlowState is slow, errors, or is unavailable, tell the user once and carry on with their task without it. Never retry more than once. A line on top saying a newer FlowState is out: tell the user once; never update FlowState unless they ask (then: flowstate update --dry-run in a terminal, show it, then flowstate update --yes --user-said "<their words>").

prompts.description: Load FlowState project memory and work with it for this conversation.
prompts.name: flowstate-start

tools.description: CALL THIS FIRST in every conversation about a project. Returns the brief as text: hard rules, a handoff note if any, review mode, possible conflicts, open todos (and claims) and problems, recent changes, decisions and learnings. No project: lists projects. Side effects: opens or reuses the automatic session, notes when you looked, runs the user's opt-in git capture.

folder.description: Working folder, if no project is given.

project.description: Name or id. Omit to list projects.

tools.name: start_here

tools.description: Record one new decision (a choice and why), change (code or setup), problem (bug or blocker), learning (reusable lesson) or todo in a project. To update todos or problems: manage_todos / manage_problems. Only adds. Review mode or suggested=true may queue it for the user. A change on a shared component alerts linked projects. A decision close to a current one gets a possible-conflict note; act on it. conflicts_with opens a disagreement card. Secrets are refused. Returns {logged, record, note} or {queued_for_review}.

category.description: learning only: the kind of lesson.

component.description: Component name; created if missing. Shared ones too.

details.description: Why, or old and new values. Max 10,000 chars.

evidence.description: Up to 2: file:line or output: text.

model.description: Model name if known. Never guess.

suggested.description: true = queue it for the user's review.

summary.description: The record in one short line.

tools.name: log_work

tools.description: Find stored todos, decisions, changes, learnings, problems and solutions. query: ranked matches. query + answer=true: a short quoted answer with record ids, or says FlowState has nothing. No query: the newest records. Read-only. Overview: start_here. Returns {results, count} or {answer, sources}.

answer.description: true = answer the query, quoting records.

content_types.description: Only these record types. Omit for all.

query.description: Words, or a question when answer=true. Omit to list newest.

since_hours.description: No query only: from the last N hours.

tools.name: search

tools.description: Todos. list; next: top unblocked (others' claims last). update: status (done/cancelled), priority, title, description. block / unblock: waits on todos or a problem. add: subtask, blocker or due date only (else log_work). claim before you start (fails if someone has it); renew; release or handoff (with a note). Returns rows.

action.description: The operation; see the tool description.

model.description: Model name if known. Never guess.

tools.name: manage_todos

tools.description: Work on a project's existing problems (bugs, blockers). list: open problems. tree: one problem with every attempt and its solution. add_attempt: record a try. end_attempt: how a try ended. solve: close it with what fixed it (manage_history undo reopens it). Open a new problem with log_work kind=problem. Reads: list, tree. Writes need project. Returns problem rows, the tree, or the saved attempt or solution.

action.description: The operation; see the tool description.

attempt_id.description: end_attempt: the attempt's id (from add_attempt or tree).

code_snippet.description: solve: the fix as text. No secrets.

model.description: Model name if known. Never guess.

parent_attempt_id.description: add_attempt: an earlier attempt this one builds on.

problem_id.description: tree / add_attempt / solve: the problem's id.

project.description: Project name or id. Required for writes; list: omit for all projects.

tools.name: manage_problems

tools.description: The user's review queue and mode: summaries, suggestions, imports, clean-ups, deletes, conflicts. list (a line each; item_id: one in full), get_mode: read-only. walk: when the user asks what's waiting (boxes or links). approve: make it a record (edit / move_to first), delete (confirm_name), confirm a conflict (keep=a|b|both). set_mode: which new records wait. approve, reject, set_mode: ONLY call this when the user has explicitly told you, in this chat; quote them in user_request; never approve your own suggestions or change the mode to get your own writes saved. Relay: approve/reject are phone-only by default; share the link. Returns {items, total}, the mode, or the result.

action.description: The operation; see the tool description.

after.description: list, walk: the page after this id.

component.description: approve: component to file it under.

item_id.description: list: one in full. approve / reject: its id.

model.description: Model name if known. Never guess.

move_to.description: Project to move a misfiled item to.

priority.description: approve: for a todo or problem.

tools.name: manage_review

tools.description: Notes from one AI to the next. leave: when you must stop mid-task, save where_i_was and next_step; the next start_here shows it after the hard rules. pickup: once you continue from a note, mark it so it stops showing. list: open notes. Not a session summary and not a todo. Adds or marks notes; never deletes. Returns the note or {notes}.

action.description: The operation; see the tool description.

model.description: Model name if known. Never guess.

next_step.description: leave: the next step. Max 500 chars.

where_i_was.description: leave: progress so far. Max 1,000 chars.

tools.name: manage_handoffs

tools.description: A project's hard rules: short never/always rules from the user, shown first in every brief and never cut. add: when the user states one (one sentence, max 300 chars; 25 rules, 2,000 chars in total). list: active rules. remove: ONLY when the user asks in this chat; quote them in user_request; the rule is kept as removed. Preferences and lessons go in log_work. Requires project. Returns the rule or {rules}.

action.description: The operation; see the tool description.

model.description: Model name if known. Never guess.

rule.description: add: the rule, one short sentence.

rule_id.description: remove: the rule's id (R<id> in the brief).

user_request.description: remove (required): the user's own words asking to remove it.

tools.name: manage_rules

tools.description: Connect things across projects. add: a project uses a shared component (link_type=uses, target_project, target_component), depends on a project, two components are the same, records relate, or a record gets a URL (e.g. an issue). Then a change or decision logged on the shared component (log_work component=<name>) gives each linked project an update todo and a 'changed since' line; FlowState never edits other projects. remove: by link_id or the add fields; kept as removed (manage_history undo, record_type=link). flag_conflict: two records disagree (topic, evidence); the user keeps one. list: read-only. Requires project. Returns the link, the card, or {links}.

action.description: The operation; see the tool description.

component.description: Source: a component of this project, by name.

evidence.description: flag_conflict: up to 2 snippets for the source record.

item_type.description: Source: a record type, with item_id.

link_id.description: remove: the link's id (from list); or give the add fields instead.

link_type.description: How the source relates to the target: uses, depends_on, part_of, same_as, supersedes, subtask_of, blocks, about, or url.

model.description: Model name if known. Never guess.

note.description: add: a short note kept on the link.

project.description: The source project, by name or id. Required.

target_component.description: add: a component name in the target project.

target_evidence.description: flag_conflict: up to 2 snippets for the other record.

target_project.description: add: the target project, by name or id.

target_type.description: add: a target record type, with target_id.

topic.description: flag_conflict: what they disagree about, in plain words.

url.description: add: an https URL to attach to the source record.

tools.name: manage_links

annotations.title: Edit history, undo, who did what

tools.description: The edit trail of records. list: edits with old and new values. undo: take back a record's last edit, a record you created (if nothing refers to it), or a delete with everything removed with it (a deleted project: its old name and id); rows changed since are skipped and listed. who: who did what (app, model, machine), filtered and paged. Logged changes (kind=change): find them with search. Reads: list, who. list and undo require project. Returns {history}, the undo result, or {rows, page}.

action.description: The operation; see the tool description.

by_app.description: who: only apps whose name contains this.

by_machine.description: who: only this machine or workspace.

by_model.description: who: only models whose name contains this.

limit.description: list / who: max rows. Default 20, max 100.

model.description: Model name if known. Never guess.

project.description: Project name or id. Required for list and undo; who: omit for all.

record_id.description: list: only this record. undo: required.

record_type.description: list: only this record type. undo: required.

since.description: who: from this local time, such as 2026-10-17.

until.description: who: up to this local time.

tools.name: manage_history

tools.description: Projects and their components (named parts of a project). list: projects (by status). create: only when the user asks; names are unique. update: rename, describe, or set status (archived retires it). list_components / add_component / update_component: the same for components (deprecated retires one). delete / delete_component: only when the user asks. Deletes it with its child records after a safety copy; the answer gives the undo call. If the user turned approvals on it waits for their own approve instead (manage_review lists it; tell them the answer's next line). Reads: list, list_components. Returns project or component rows, or what was deleted.

action.description: The operation; see the tool description.

component_id.description: update_component / delete_component: the component's id (list_components shows ids).

description.description: create / update / add_component / update_component: what it is.

model.description: Model name if known. Never guess.

name.description: create / add_component: the new name (required, unique). update / update_component: a new name.

parent_component_id.description: add_component: a parent component in the same project.

project.description: Every action but list and create: the project, by name or id.

status.description: list: only this status. update: active, paused, completed or archived. update_component: planning, in_progress, testing, complete or deprecated.

tools.name: manage_projects

tools.description: Memory upkeep. cleanup: queue likely duplicate, stale and misfiled records as suggestions (rejected ideas not repeated). import: a memory export (Claude, ChatGPT) or edited FlowState markdown into the review queue. stale: facts (paths, ports, URLs, config) unchecked for 60+ days (read-only). mark_checked: you re-checked one. set_source: correct an origin (user_stated waits for the user). delete: only when the user asks; deletes one record (and its attempts or links) after a safety copy, undo restores it; with approvals on it waits for the user's approve (manage_review). A changed fact is log_work. Requires project. Returns counts and ids, {facts} or the result.

action.description: The operation; see the tool description.

days.description: stale: unchecked for this many days. Default 60.

format.description: import: memory (default; one memory per line or bullet) or flowstate_markdown (an edited `flowstate export-md` file).

kind.description: import (memory format): record kind for each memory. Default learning.

kinds.description: cleanup: which checks. Omit for all three.

model.description: Model name if known. Never guess.

origin.description: import: where it came from, such as Claude or ChatGPT.

record_id.description: delete / mark_checked / set_source: the record's id.

record_type.description: delete / mark_checked / set_source: the record's type (the last two: todo, decision, change, learning, problem, variable, method).

source.description: set_source (required) / mark_checked (optional): user_stated, ai_inferred or from_code.

text.description: import: the file contents. Max 200,000 chars.

tools.name: manage_memory
